en.t: No, something like that could not possibly happen...

units.source_text: 就算是眼睛的错觉，也不可能……

en.t: Even if it were an optical illusion, it still could not be...

units.source_text: 不管怎样的斜坡，由下往上看，当然要比实际情况差得多。

en.t: No matter what kind of slope it was, seen from below, it would naturally look much worse than it really was.
